final: WITH step1 AS (SELECT TR.transreg, TR.ordertypedist, AVG(SF.instownpct) as instownpct FROM sentimentandfundamentals SF JOIN transactionrecord TR ON SF.transref = TR.transreg GROUP BY TR.transreg, TR.ordertypedist), step2 AS (SELECT ordertypedist, AVG(instownpct) as avg_instownpct FROM step1 GROUP BY ordertypedist), step3 AS (SELECT s1.transreg, s1.ordertypedist, s1.instownpct, s1.instownpct / s2.avg_instownpct as ratio FROM step1 s1 JOIN step2 s2 ON s1.ordertypedist = s2.ordertypedist), step4 AS (SELECT AVG(instownpct) as overall_avg FROM step3), step5 AS (SELECT s3.transreg, s3.ordertypedist, s3.instownpct, s3.ratio, s3.instownpct - s4.overall_avg as difference FROM step3 s3 CROSS JOIN step4 s4 WHERE s3.instownpct > s4.overall_avg) SELECT AVG(instownpct), AVG(ratio), AVG(difference) FROM step5
